title: ISic000070. Fragmentary Imperial honorific
body:
Text encoding: Tuuli Ahlholm
1[---col(onia)] Aug(usta)
2[Tyndarit(anorum) d]evota
3[numini ei]ụs ❦

Text encoding: Tuuli Ahlholm
1[---....]AUG
2[..........]EVOTA
3[........].S❦

Facsimile Images

Apparatus criticus

  • Text of IMusPalermo

translation

commentary

Published together with a second fragment by Mommsen, and the two fragments continue to be published together under a single number by both Bivona and Fasolo, notwithstanding the fact that Bivona correctly highlighted that the two fragments clearly belong to separate inscriptions.

bibliography

  • Mommsen 1883 7480 https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10000589
  • Bivona 1970 071a https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10002142
  • Fasolo 2013 79-80 no.19a fig.49 (mislabelled as fig.45) https://biblio.inscriptiones.org/epig10002011

Thinly incised regular letters of moderately narrow module, with straight-bar serifs; a fully curved G.
